questions.question: If you wrote down all the numbers from 1 to 99, then how many times would you have written ‘7’?
questions.solution:
In numbers 7 will appear 11 times in numbers 7,17,27,37,47,57,67,77,87,and 97(two times in 77) and 9 times in numbers 70,71,72,73,74,75,76,78 and 79. Hence it will appear in total 20 times in numbers 1 to 99.

Hence, “20” is the correct answer.

questions.question: A cube coloured pink on all faces is cut into 27 small cubes of equal sizes. How many cubes are painted on one face only?
questions.solution:
If a cube is coloured and cut into 27 small cubes of equal sizes, smaller cubes present in the middle of the edges are coloured in two colours, the cubes which are at the corners of the edges are coloured in three colours and cubes which are at the centre of each side is coloured in a single colour (as shown in the figure).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00395bb367213a6f897df013a9aee2f528f69d897fcb498a2847857d2f59614b.png] 

So there are 6 such small cubes whose one edge is coloured.

Hence, “6” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

19 : 400 ∷ 24 : _________.

Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No grass is a flower.

All flowers are trees.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are flowers.

II. Some trees are grasses.

III. No trees is a grass.

options.text: Either conclusion II or III follows
Either conclusions II or III, and I follow

questions.solution:
Statement I :No grass is a flower.

Statement II :All flowers are trees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aec794feaf8365c4b50258c67710b9c571877be6eead29032c413506914bc214.png] 

**Conclusion I:** Some trees are flowers → True

**Conclusion II:** Some trees are grasses → False(it is possible but not definite)

**Conclusion III:** No trees is a grass. → False(it is possible but not definite)

Here, Conclusion II and III makes complimentary pairs.

Hence, “Either conclusions II or III, and I follow” is the correct answer.

questions.question: The 'Instrument of Surrender' which ended the Portuguese rule in India was signed on _______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The 'Instrument of Surrender' which ended the Portuguese rule in India was signed on **19th December 1961**__.
 
• This ended 450 years of Portuguese in India.
 
• Francisco de Almeida was the first Viceroy of the Portuguese state and its headquarter was Cochin.
 
• The movement to end the Portuguese rule was called the Goa Liberation Movement.

questions.question: The East India Company sent Captain William Hawkins to the court of Emperor _______ in 1608 to seek permission to open a factory at Surat.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The East India Company sent Captain William Hawkins to the court of Emperor **Jahangir**__ in 1608 to seek permission to open a factory at Surat.
 
• He was well versed with Turkish and Jahangir also knew some of it since it was the native tongue of Mughal Emperor Babur.
 
• He was called 'English Khan' by Jahangir.
 
• William Hawkins was the commander of Hector, the first ship of the British East India Company to anchor at Surat in 1608.

questions.question: Which team won the Ranji Trophy 2018-19?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Team **Vidarbha**__ won the Ranji Trophy 2018-19.
 
• This was the 85th season of the trophy, where team Saurashtra and team Vidarbha competed in the finals.
 
• Team Saurashtra was defeated by 78 runs.
 
• This was the second successive Ranji Trophy title of Vidarbha.
 
• BCCI presented them a cash prize of Rs. 2 crore, while the Vidarbha Cricket Association presented Rs. 3 crore.

questions.question: The Khadi and village Industries Commission Act was passed in the year _______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Khadi and village Industries Commission Act was passed in the year **1956**__.
 
• Through this Act, a statutory body was established- Khadi and Village Industries Commission.
 
• It works under the Ministry of MSME and aims to organise, promote and plan the development and establishment of khadi industries in the rural areas.

questions.question: Name the smallest district in India.
questions.solution:
__
 
• By area, **Mahe**__ in Puducherry is the smallest district in India.
 
• The district is spread across an area of 9 sq km.
 
• As per 2001 census, it has a population of 36,000, while the population density is 4091 sq. km.
 
• Kutch in Gujarat is the largest district of India in terms of area.
 
• Leh is the second largest district of India.

questions.question: The movement of the local farmers of Bardoli in Gujarat against the British in 1928 was led by _______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The movement of the local farmers of Bardoli in Gujarat against the British in 1928 was led by **Vallabhbhai Patel**__.
 
• It was done against the unjust raising of taxes.
 
• It is considered as a major revolt of the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• Its success gave rise to Vallabhbhai Patel, thus making him one of the important leaders of the Indian freedom struggle.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian to win the Miss Universe title?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Sushmita Sen**__ was the first Indian to win the Miss Universe title.
 
• She won the pageant in the year 1994.
 
• She was also crowned Miss India in the year 1994.
 
• Reita Faria was the first Indian and Asian to win the Miss World title in 1966.
 
• Madhu Sapre won the Miss India title in 1992.
 
• Persis Khambatta won the Miss India title in 1965.

questions.question: An adult human body has _______ bones.
questions.solution:
__
 
• An adult human body has **206**__ bones.
 
• The internal framework of the human body forms the human skeleton.
 
• At the time of birth, there are around 300 bones present in the body.
 
• The human skeleton is divided into 2 parts, namely appendicular skeleton and axial skeleton.

questions.question: As of 2018, Indian is the leading milk producing country in the world, accounting for approximately _______ of the global market share.
questions.solution:
__
 
• As of 2018, India is the leading milk producing country in the world, accounting for approximately **19%**__ of the global market share.
 
• This data was released by the Dairy and Milk Processing Market in India (2018-2023).
 
• The industry is expected to expand at an annual rate of 14.8% between FY 2018-2023.
 
• Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh are the major milk producing states of India.
 
• UP is the largest milk producing state and also has the highest buffalo population.

questions.question: _______ is the hottest planet in the solar system.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Venus**__ is the hottest planet in the solar system.
 
• The temperature on Venus reaches around 465 degrees Celsius, which is hot enough to melt lead.
 
• It is the second planet from the sun and is named after a Roman Goddess.
 
• Earth and Venus are called twins since they are the same in size, density, and mass.
 
• The coldest planet of the solar system is Uranus.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the 'Char Dham Yatra' in North India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Vaishno Devi **__is not a part of the 'Char Dham Yatra' in North India.
 
• The temple is located in Katra in Jammu.
 
• Char Dham comprise of 4 pilgrimage sites in North India, in the state of Uttarakhand.
 
• These are Gangotri, Yamunotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath.
 
• Char Dham of India are Rameswaram, Puri, Dwarka, and Badrinath.

• The sun contains 99.86% of all the mass of the solar system.
 
• The weight of the sun is 333,000 times as much as Earth.

questions.question: Name the oldest operating port in India built by the British East India Company.

• The second largest port by volume of cargo handled is the Vishakapatnam Port.

questions.question: What was the historical name of the city of Guwahati?
questions.solution:

questions.question: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act was passed in the year _______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act was passed in the year **2006**__.
 
• It regulates and classifies enterprises as small, medium, and micro enterprises.
 
• It classifies MSMEs on the basis of investment in equipment and plant and machinery.
 
• Nitin Gadkari is the Minister of MSME currently.

questions.question: ________ is a hearing-impaired Indian golfer who won her first professional title at the age of 18. In March 2019, she became the second Indian golfer to win on the 'Ladies European Tour'.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Diksha Dagar**__ is a hearing-impaired Indian golfer who won her first professional title at the age of 18.
 
• In March 2019, she became the second Indian golfer to win on the 'Ladies European Tour'.
 
• In November 2015, she became number 1 amateur female golfer of India.
 
• She also represented India at the Summer Deaflympics 2017.

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Mandhan Yojana ensures old age protection for unorganised workers whose monthly income is less than or equal to _______.
questions.solution:
• Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan is a voluntary and contributory Pension Scheme for Unorganized Workers for entry age of 18 to 40 years with monthly income of Rs. 15000 or less.
 
• Under this scheme, each subscriber will receive an assured pension of minimum Rs.3000 every month upon reaching the age of 60 years.
 
• People from the unorganized sector can contribute between Rs.55 to Rs.200 monthly to be eligible for the scheme.

questions.question: The Ayushman Bharat Scheme introduced by the Government of India provides medical coverage of upto Rs. _______ per family per year.
questions.solution:
__

• It is a national health insurance scheme.
 
• It is the world's largest government-funded healthcare scheme.
 
• It was renamed as PM Jan Arogya Yojana and is targeted at poor rural families.

questions.question: In 2015, aircraft make Boeing developed a metal called _______, which is lighter than air and strong than steel.
questions.solution:

• It was developed by a research team of HRL laboratories in 2011.
 
• It was designed as the structural component in aerospace engineering.
 
• Although it is light in weight, but it displays good strength.

questions.question: During the Sao Joao festivities, Goans present _______ to each other.
questions.solution:
__

• The Sao Joao festival is celebrated in Goa to pay tribute to St. John the Baptist.
 
• It is held at the beginning of monsoon, on June 24.
 
• St. John was the relative of Mother Mary.

questions.question: Wilson's disease is an inherited disorder in which excessive amount of _______ accumulate in the body.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Wilson's disease is an inherited disorder in which excessive amount of **copper**__ accumulates in the body.
 
• It accumulated majorly in brain and liver.
 
• Some of its symptoms include fatigue, eye discoloration, yellowing of the skin, etc.
 
• If it is untreated, the disease can become fatal too.

questions.question: _______ was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India.

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 129°. Then, ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770f8a89e831d21936ac72dbd84459b80d951037f5a1fe54d4b9deedc70e7c47.png] 

Given ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, and ∠ADC = 129°

As we know, the sum of the either pair of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 129° = 51°

In ΔACB, if AB is diameter, then ∠ACB = 90°

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠ABC + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 90° + 51° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° – 90° – 51° = 39°

questions.question: A starts walking at 4 kmph and after 4 hours, B starts cycling from the same point as that of A, in the same direction at 10 kmph. After how much distance from the starting point will B catch up with A (Correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
Speed of A = 4 km/h

Distance covered by A in 4 hours = 4 × 4 = 16 km

Speed of B = 10 km/h

Time taken by B to catch up with A = 16/(10 – 4) = 16/6 = 8/3 hr

Total distance covered by B in 8/3 hrs = 10 × 8/3 = 80/3 = 26.67 km

questions.question: What is the difference between a single discount of 30% and a single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5%, being given on shopping of Rs. 2,000?
questions.solution:
**Short trick: **

Single Successive equivalent discount of 25% and 5%

⇒ 25 + 5 – [(25 × 5)/100] = (30 – 1.25)%

Required difference between a single discount of 30% and single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 5% = 30% – (30 – 1.25)% = 30 – 30 + 1.25 = 1.25%

Required difference = Rs. 2000 × 1.25/100 = Rs. 25

**Detailed solution: **

Shopping price after discount = Rs. 2000 × 70/100 = 1400

Shopping price after two successive discounts of 25% and 5% = Rs. 2000 × 75/100 × 95/100 = 1425

Required difference = 1425 – 1400 = Rs. 25

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 50°. Its sides AB and AC are produced to the point D and E. If the bisectors of the ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at the point O, then ∠BOC will be equal to:

Given, ∠A = 50°

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 50/2

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – 25° = 65°

questions.question: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days. A woman does triple the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does. How many women alone will be able to complete this work in 4 days?
questions.solution:
3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 6 days

According to the question

⇒ W = 3M

⇒ M : W = 1 : 3

⇒ B = M/2

⇒ M : B = 2 : 1

Efficiency of man, woman and boy (M : W : B) = 2 : 6 : 1

Total work = (3M + 4W + 6B) × 6

⇒ (3 × 2 + 4 × 6 + 6 × 1) × 6 = 216

Suppose x women alone can complete that work in 4 days, then

⇒ x × 6 × 4 = 216

⇒ x = 9 days

questions.question: If 3 cos² A + 7 sin² A = 4, then what is the value of cot A, given that A is an acute angle?

⇒ 3(cos²A + sin² A) + 4 sin²A = 4

⇒ 3 × 1 + 4 sin² A = 4

⇒ 4 sin²A = 4 – 3 = 1

⇒ sin²A = 1/4

⇒ sin A = 1/2

⇒ sin A = sin 30°

⇒ A = 30°

⇒ cot A = cot 30° = √3
